name: a11y-conformance-report
description: Writes a WCAG-EM style evaluation report and a per-criterion conformance table for all WCAG 2.2 level A and AA success criteria, using the ITI VPAT 2.5 conformance terms (Supports, Partially Supports, Does Not Support, Not Applicable), deriving each verdict only from re-test evidence and listing every open issue and every test not run.
